evidence_challenges.claim: The disease has a high fatality rate.
evidence_challenges.note: Supplied as a case fact; real deployments require source evidence and ongoing validation.

evidence_challenges.claim: Temporary movement restrictions materially reduce transmission and less restrictive measures are insufficient.
evidence_challenges.note: Supplied as a case fact; this is the key necessity dependency and must be re-evaluated if evidence changes.

checks.reason: Restriction is coercive, but may be justified only if bounded by necessity/proportionality safeguards.
The stated objective is transmission control, not punishment of a group.

principle_assessments.reason: The proposal addresses a severe threat to life and health.
Movement restrictions materially interfere with agency and require strong justification and limits.
Application must track relevant transmission risk and avoid arbitrary/discriminatory targeting.
People with fewer resources may bear disproportionate practical burdens and need support/voice.
Given the supplied fact that less restrictive effective measures are insufficient, a temporary bounded restriction can satisfy necessity subject to safeguards.
Independent review, explanation, appeal/correction and expiry are required for consequential emergency power.
The emergency determination must remain open to evidence and cannot self-perpetuate.

principle_conflicts.conflict: Protection of life requires an effective transmission intervention while movement restrictions interfere with agency.
principle_conflicts.resolution_or_status: Under the supplied facts, MC-10 permits the minimum effective temporary restriction, not unlimited emergency authority.

alternatives_analysis.constitutional_note: Normally preferable for agency, but the case stipulates they are insufficient to control the severe threat.
alternatives_analysis.dominance_note: Does not achieve the legitimate protective objective under supplied facts.

alternatives_analysis.constitutional_note: Can achieve the protective objective while remaining conditional, reviewable and support-backed.
alternatives_analysis.dominance_note: Preferred if safeguards are actually implemented and necessity is periodically re-proved.

alternatives_analysis.constitutional_note: Uses more power and duration than justified by the supplied evidence.
alternatives_analysis.dominance_note: Constitutionally dominated by a bounded/reviewable intervention.

reasoning_summary: The severe health threat and stipulated insufficiency of less restrictive measures can justify a temporary movement restriction, but only as the least intrusive effective intervention with continuing evidential review, non-discrimination, support for burdened people and independent accountability.
required_safeguards: Defined narrow public-health purpose and scope.
Explicit expiry and frequent evidence review.
Termination or narrowing when necessity ends.
Material support for people required to isolate.
Accessible humanitarian/medical exemptions and error correction.
Minimum necessary data collection and no unrelated reuse without separate authority.
Independent oversight and route of appeal/challenge.
Public explanation of evidence and uncertainty consistent with privacy/security.
uncertainties: Real implementations would require source-backed estimates of severity, effectiveness and alternatives rather than accepting scenario assertions indefinitely.
evidence_that_could_change_result: Reliable evidence that the disease severity is materially lower.
Reliable evidence that quarantine is ineffective or creates greater net serious harm.
Availability of a less intrusive measure that achieves the protective objective.
Evidence that restrictions are being applied for unrelated political, commercial or discriminatory purposes.

validity.review_by: Short interval appropriate to the rapidly changing evidence base.
stop_conditions: Restriction no longer necessary to achieve the protective objective.
A less intrusive effective alternative becomes available.
Safeguards or independent review cease to operate.
re_evaluate_on: Material change in disease severity/transmission evidence.

enforcement_recommendation.reason: Conditional constitutional permission only while necessity, proportionality and accountability safeguards remain satisfied.
conditions: Bind authorization to an expiry/review mechanism.
Prevent unrelated reuse of powers/data without a new evaluation.
enforcement_recommendation.required_authority: Independent public-health/legal oversight appropriate to the jurisdiction.
